lines.text: People ask which cloud LokalBot sends their meetings to. By default, none. It all runs inside your Mac, so let's open it.
Under the app, there are three layers: the models, the engines that run them, and your library.
Five models, each with one job: turning speech into text, telling speakers apart, writing your notes, finishing your sentences, and searching by meaning.
Together, nine point six gigabytes of files, downloaded once.
Three engines run them on your Mac's own chip, with nothing else to install.
Whatever they produce lands in one folder: plain files, and a single database for search.
Model files and updates come in. Your work goes out only where you send it: a remote model, an agent, your phone.
Close it up, and it's all still in there.
LokalBot. Local by default, free and open source.
